fields.name: Banana Chips Classic
fields.description: Hand-sliced premium Nendran bananas, deep-fried in pure coconut oil for that unmistakable golden crunch and traditional Kerala flavor. A perfect blend of health and taste.

fields.name: Spicy Mixture
fields.description: A fiery and crunchy medley of sev, fried lentils, peanuts, and curry leaves, seasoned with a secret blend of South Indian spices for a bold and addictive snack experience.

fields.name: Tapioca Chips
fields.description: Thinly sliced cassava roots, kettle-fried to perfection and lightly salted. A naturally gluten-free snack with a satisfyingly hard crunch and earthy undertones.

fields.name: Jackfruit Chips
fields.description: Golden slices of ripe jackfruit, fried to preserve their unique tropical sweetness and aroma. A seasonal delicacy from the heart of Kerala, enjoyed worldwide.

fields.name: Sweet Plantain Chips
fields.description: Ripe plantains sliced thin and fried until caramelized. These chips offer a perfect balance of natural fruit sweetness and a crispy, melt-in-your-mouth texture.

fields.name: Kerala Murukku
fields.description: Traditional spiral-shaped snack made from a savory blend of rice flour and urad dal, flavored with cumin and sesame seeds. The ultimate crispy tea-time companion.

fields.name: Chilli Powder
fields.description: Grown in the sun-drenched fields of Guntur, our chilli powder is finely ground to provide a consistent heat level and a vibrant red color to all your culinary creations.

fields.name: Turmeric Powder
fields.description: High-curcumin Alleppey turmeric, known for its deep golden hue and medicinal properties. Stone-ground to retain its natural essential oils and rich, earthy aroma.

fields.name: Coriander Powder
fields.description: Cool-ground coriander seeds that preserve the delicate floral and citrus notes. An essential base for creating authentic, aromatic Indian curries and spice rubs.

fields.name: Black Pepper Whole
fields.description: Hand-harvested Tellicherry black peppercorns, prized for their large size and complex, fruity pungency. Perfect for fresh grinding to elevate any gourmet dish.

fields.name: Cardamom Pods
fields.description: Extra-large green cardamom pods from the Idukki hills. Intensely fragrant with sweet, eucalyptus notes, ideal for both festive biryanis and delicate desserts.

fields.name: Garam Masala
fields.description: A heritage blend of twelve whole spices including cinnamon, cloves, and mace. Roasted and ground in small batches for maximum potency, warmth, and flavor.

fields.name: Mango Pickle
fields.description: Raw green mangoes marinated in a spicy brine of mustard, fenugreek, and cold-pressed gingelly oil. A tangy, traditional staple that pairs perfectly with rice and curd.

fields.name: Lemon Pickle
fields.description: Sun-ripened lemons preserved with sea salt and fiery red chillies. The long curing process creates a soft, jammy texture with a sharp, refreshing, and spicy tang.

fields.name: Garlic Pickle
fields.description: Whole cloves of robust garlic slow-cooked in a spicy, aromatic gravy. This pickle offers a deep, savory umami punch that enhances the flavor of any meal.

fields.name: Mixed Veg Pickle
fields.description: A colorful crunch of fresh carrots, cauliflower, and green chillies preserved in a traditional spice blend. A versatile and healthy accompaniment for everyday meals.

fields.name: Gooseberry Pickle
fields.description: Whole Indian gooseberries (Amla) infused with a potent mix of traditional spices. Packed with Vitamin C and a unique blend of sour, bitter, and spicy notes.

fields.name: Tender Mango Pickle
fields.description: Exquisite baby mangoes (Kadumango) kept whole and preserved in a spicy, watery brine. A prized Kerala delicacy known for its intense and refreshing flavor.

fields.name: Sharkara Varatti
fields.description: Chunky plantain pieces deep-fried and generously coated with thick jaggery, ginger powder, and cumin. A classic wedding feast (Sadhya) essential and a sweet treat.

fields.name: Achappam
fields.description: Delicate and crunchy rose-shaped cookies made from a batter of fine rice flour and fresh coconut milk. A visual and culinary delight that represents Kerala's heritage.

fields.name: Kuzhalappam
fields.description: Tube-shaped fried snacks with a unique roasted flour taste, flavored with onion, garlic, and sesame. A crispy, savory companion perfectly suited for your evening tea.

fields.name: Banana Halwa
fields.description: A slow-cooked masterpiece made from ripe bananas, jaggery, and pure ghee. This dark, chewy halwa is a signature sweet known for its rich, caramelized, and decadent flavor.

fields.name: Peanut Chikki
fields.description: Traditional energy bars made with premium roasted peanuts and pure jaggery. A crunchy, nutty, and healthy treat that provides an instant natural energy boost.

fields.name: Sesame Balls
fields.description: Wholesome spheres of toasted sesame seeds bound together with melted jaggery. A nutrient-dense snack with a rich, nutty aroma and a satisfyingly sweet finish.

fields.name: Alexander Harvard
fields.content: Bchippas consistently delivers the highest quality authentic Kerala snacks. Their B2B supply chain is phenomenal and highly reliable.

fields.name: Maria Smith
fields.content: We have been sourcing spices and pickles from Bchippas for over two years. The hygiene and packing standards are truly world-class.

fields.name: John Doe
fields.content: Our customers absolutely love the Tapioca and Banana chips. The authentic taste keeps them coming back for more.
